explanation.headline: Propranolol hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list; both Corvale sites use product from Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) which received an OAI inspection in 2009 and a Warning Letter in 2010, with the most recent inspection VAI on 2026-07-16

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include propranolol hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 92 tablets of the 40 mg presentation, providing 7.5 days of supply at 12.3 tablets per day.
Corvale General holds 425 tablets of the same presentation, providing 29.3 days of supply at 14.5 tablets per day.
Both sites' inventory is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) per NDC 71335236909.
FDA inspection 590126 at that plant ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2009-09-09.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same facility on 2010-04-08.
The most recent inspection (1326578) ended 2026-07-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2026-10-14.
